sentences.japanese: 機械は多くの人手を省く。
この機会のおかげで私たちは大いに手間暇が省けた。
sentences.english: Thanks to the opportunity, we were able to avoid substantial effort.

sentences.japanese: それでだいぶ手間が省ける。
sentences.english: That will save me a lot of trouble.

sentences.japanese: その省は内政問題の行政をつかさどる。
sentences.english: The ministry administers the internal affairs.

sentences.japanese: その橋のおかげで彼らは時間と労力が大いに省けた。
sentences.english: The bridge saved them a lot of time and trouble.
